mints.t: AI agent spending ledger with caps
mints.say: An AI can spend, but not without a human signature.
mints.note: Platform data contract logs agent spends; 2-of-3 identity keys approve.
mints.why: AI agent commerce needs oversight rails.

mints.t: Notarize any file on-chain in one second
mints.say: Proof lives in the stars, not a server.
mints.note: Hash file → Dash tx → InstantSend lock → ChainLock proof.
mints.why: Timestamping needs speed and absolute finality.

mints.t: DPNS name marketplace with expiry waves
mints.say: Names are tides; they return to the sea.
mints.note: Data contract tracks listings; DPNS transfer on purchase.
mints.why: Username liquidity and fair renewal cycles.

mints.t: Lend Platform credits, earn DASH interest
mints.say: Credit is the fuel; let others borrow yours.
mints.note: Token contract holds pooled credits; interest via withdrawal fees.

mints.say: The network's heartbeat, visible to all.
mints.note: DAPI fetches quorum status; data contract stores snapshots.

mints.t: Send private memos with CoinJoin stealth
mints.say: A message only the intended eyes can trace.
mints.note: Memo in OP_RETURN; payment mixed via wallet CoinJoin.

mints.t: Visualize treasury proposals competing for funds
mints.say: Democracy is a ranked list of wants.
mints.note: DashCentral API feeds live tallies; sim ranks by net votes.

mints.t: Build and test Drive queries visually
mints.say: A query is a key; design the lock first.
mints.note: Simulates DocumentQuery against a schema; validates indices.
